title: Execution of the input-fold machine
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be an alphabet, let $A$ be a set, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $x$ be a word over $\Gamma$. Given a state update rule $\delta:A\to\Gamma\to A$, an initial value $a_0\in A$, and a configuration $d$ on input $x$ in state $(\mathrm{fwd},a_0)$ with its input head at position $1$, after $2|x|+2$ steps the machine is in state $(\mathrm{done},\operatorname{foldl}(\delta,a_0,x))$, with all other configuration data unchanged. Before that time it is never in any done state, and throughout the execution every work-tape head remains at its initial position.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
The input head of $d$ is at position $1$
